bio.text: Steve Unger is a Republican member of the Arkansas House of Representatives for District 19, which covers part of Washington County.
The legislature's member page lists Unger's first House term as 2023 and shows Unger as a veteran.

According to the House of Representatives biography, Unger was born and raised in Springdale, where Unger lives, and holds degrees from the University of Arkansas, Midwestern Baptist Theological Seminary and the Marine Corps Command and Staff College.
The biography says Unger retired from the Navy as a captain after 32 years of active-duty service.
